verdict.rationale: An authenticator app could plausibly offer programmatic access to its stored codes, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents touch-based UI actions (swipe to edit or delete, drag to reorder, QR export and scan) and Google Account sync, with no API for any of them. The GitHub OTP generator implementations and PAM module are developer building blocks, not an API that matches the app's UI functions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
